title: THE HOSTILES PLATE MATCHES THE EXTRACT BANNER WIDTH
why: Critic on screen 37: the hostiles closing in plate was a narrower pill touching the countdown plate. It now takes the banner width and sits 8 px under it.
now: The hostiles closing in plate is as wide as the extract countdown plate, with a gap between them.

edits.replacement:
var _exBan=_exBelt-LH(62)*_exR;   // the headline above it; v32.xx (cw-hostcol) 14 px higher so the hostiles plate has an 8 px gap under it
  var _exBW=0;   // width of the banner plate, shared with the hostiles plate under it
